A Small Factory Cuts Waste
Merrin Tools began collecting metal scraps separately from general waste in January. A local recycler now picks them up every Wednesday and returns a monthly weight report. In the first three months, disposal costs fell by 18 percent. Production manager Imani Ross says the reports also revealed which cutting process creates the most scrap. The company will use that information when it replaces two machines next year.
